mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_INFO (CLI_CODE, ORDER_ID, STATUS, ORDER_DATE) VALUES (#{cliCode}, #{orderId}, #{status}, #{orderDate})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.WORKFLOW_STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME FROM ORDER_INFO oi LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM it ON it.ORDER_NUM = oi.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE ORDER BY oi.ORDER_DATE DESC, oi.ORDER_NUM DESC, it.ITEM_NUM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_INFO SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ORDER_NUM = #{orderNum}
UPDATE ORDER_INFO SET ORDER_DATE = #{orderDate} WHERE ORDER_NUM = #{orderNum}
mapper.select: SELECT oi.ORDER_NUM, it.ITEM_NUM, oi.ORDER_ID, oi.ORDER_DATE, oi.STATUS, oi.WORKFLOW_STATUS, oi.CLI_CODE, ci.CLI_COMP_NAME, it.PRODUCT, it.PRODUCT_LABEL, it.WIDTH, it.LENGTH, it.ROLLS, it.DESTINATION, it.NOTE, it.DELIVERY_DATE, it.UNIT_PRICE, it.ALIAS_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM it JOIN ORDER_INFO oi ON oi.ORDER_NUM = it.ORDER_NUM LEFT JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_CODE = oi.CLI_CODE WHERE it.ITEM_NUM = #{itemNum}
